dhk_sbaa.text: The Sovereign Base Areas are administered separately from the Republic of Cyprus. We run the roads, the police, the courts and the schools. And the paperwork.
About half the staff are Cypriot, and the rest are British. If you ever need a stamp, this is the building.

dhk_clerk.text: Please take a number. It's your number, you can keep it. Nobody has called for ninety minutes, but we do believe in queuing.
The local joke is that the only thing that moves faster than a tortoise in Cyprus is a form from this office.
